mapper.insert: INSERT INTO b_official ( gmt_create, gmt_modify, name, phone, email, state, image_url, region_id, specialty, work_state, grade_id) VALUES ( now(), now(), #{name}, #{phone}, #{email}, 'ENABLED', #{imageUrl}, #{regionId}, #{specialty}, #{workState}, #{gradeId});

INSERT INTO b_official_evaluate ( gmt_create, gmt_modify, adviser_id, official_id, professionalism, accuracy, timely_communication, collaboration_time, reason_low_score, remark) VALUES ( now(), now(), #{adviserId}, #{officialId}, #{professionalism}, #{accuracy}, #{timelyCommunication}, #{collaborationTime}, #{reasonLowScore}, #{remark});
mapper.select: SELECT id, gmt_create AS gmtCreate, name, phone, email, state, image_url AS imageUrl, region_id AS regionId, specialty AS specialty, work_state AS workState, grade_id AS gradeId FROM b_official WHERE id = #{id, jdbcType=INTEGER};

SELECT id, gmt_create AS gmtCreate, name, phone, email, state, image_url AS imageUrl, region_id AS regionId, specialty AS specialty, work_state AS workState, grade_id AS gradeId FROM b_official WHERE grade_id = #{gradeId, jdbcType=INTEGER};
SELECT count(*) FROM tb_admin_user WHERE is_official_admin = 1 and official_id = #{id, jdbcType=INTEGER};
